en: The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a townscape featuring several traditional European buildings with tiled roofs. In the foreground, there is a curved building with wooden balconies, laundry hanging out to dry, and a man standing on a small balcony or stairway. The upper left of the image contains red printed text: 'Grossenhain.' The overall appearance of the image suggests a late 19th or early 20th-century European town.
